starting.card: Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place

description: Very fast SURPRISE deck. Looks like a regular BHBM on the surface, but when you look between the lines...
cards: Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place
Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith
notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting(8)': Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place (posted 'BHBM/TYFP'), Death Star II: Throne Room, Your Destiny, Insignificant Rebellion, There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement, Imperial Arrest Order, Mobilization Points, Prepared Defenses; these count toward the 60. Several Effects start, none is named as the starting Effect, so starting.effect is left empty.
'The Party Favor(1)' and 'Blue Stuff(7)' are the post's section headings (Blue Stuff = starships), not cards.
Posted 'Vader's Toy' (the only card under 'The Party Favor') is kept as written: it names no card and the strategy does not mention it. It may be Vader's Lightsaber or Vader's Custom TIE.
Posted 'Grabber' is kept as written: it names no card. (The draft's Allegations Of Corruption is a Coruscant-set card, not yet printed in April 2001.)

Posted 'CCDB' dested Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay); 'DSIIDB' Death Star II: Docking Bay; 'SpaceportDB' Spaceport Docking Bay (Dark); 'EndorDB' Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay) (Dark), as in his other April 2001 lists.

Posted 'Dengar in POS' dested Dengar In Punishing One; 'Fett in S1' Boba Fett In Slave I; 'Bossk in HT' Bossk In Hound's Tooth; 'IG in IG' IG-88 In IG-2000; 'Zuckuss in MH' Zuckuss In Mist Hunter; 'Chimera' Chimaera.

Posted 'Choke Vader' dested Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith; 'Janus' Janus Greejatus; 'Mobil. Points' Mobilization Points; 'Sec. Precautions' Security Precautions; 'Twilek Advisor' Twi'lek Advisor; 'TINT/Oppressive Enforcement' There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement.
